scenarios.input: Run skill-doctor for this project using only Copilot sessions. Do not execute tools. Describe collection and scoring in four short bullets.
scenarios.rationale: A project request must not collect every local conversation. Collection precedes model-based scoring.

scenarios.desc: Deterministic observations seed bootstrap without proving friction
scenarios.input: The skill-doctor inventory contains repeated tool calls and errors. Its report also assigns efficiency grades. Explain what skill-bootstrap may import. Do not execute tools. Answer in four short bullets.
scenarios.rationale: Deterministic counters seed discovery. Neither counters nor qualitative grades prove avoidable friction.

scenarios.input: Optimize one existing skill against its scored held-out evaluation set. Do not diagnose local sessions. Name the correct skill and stop.
scenarios.rationale: Held-out optimization uses skillopt rather than a local session diagnosis.

scenarios.desc: Static triage with no candidates is not a no-change verdict
scenarios.input: Skill-doctor scored the sessions, found workflow waste, and drafted no suggestions. No skillopt run happened. Summarize the outcome for the user in three short bullets. Do not execute tools.
scenarios.rationale: An empty static suggestion list does not show that a change would fail to help. Only a scored skillopt evaluation supports a no-change verdict.

scenarios.desc: Supported finding becomes an unevaluated candidate with handoffs
scenarios.input: A failed session shows the agent retried a deploy four times because the deploy skill never checks for the staging token. Describe the skill-doctor suggestion you would record. Do not execute tools. Answer in four short bullets.
scenarios.rationale: Diagnosis surfaces the candidate without a change bar, keeps it unevaluated, and hands evaluation to skillopt and routing to skillforge without starting either.

scenarios.desc: Report numbers come from assemble_report.py, not a hand copy
scenarios.input: Skill-doctor has scored every sampled session into scores.json and written score_artifact.json. Explain how the scores reach report.json. Do not execute tools. Answer in three short bullets.
scenarios.rationale: Step 5 writes the report without numbers and lets assemble_report.py recompute and fill them, so no reported score is copied by hand.

scenarios.desc: No manifest flag when collection skipped the audit manifest
scenarios.input: Skill-doctor collected sessions without --audit-manifest and scored them. Give the exact assemble command for report.json. Do not execute tools. Answer with the command and one sentence.
scenarios.rationale: The catalog comes only from an audit manifest the collector wrote; without one, the assemble command leaves out --manifest rather than inventing a catalog.
